overview.about: The Arnold Palmer Invitational is one of the PGA Tour's prestigious signature events, hosted at Bay Hill in Orlando - the course Arnold Palmer made his home. It carries a limited elite field and honours 'The King' with the tradition of the winner receiving a red cardigan. Tiger Woods holds the record here with eight wins.
overview.nextEvent: The next Arnold Palmer Invitational is played at Bay Hill Club and Lodge in Orlando. As a signature event it features a small, elite field competing for a large purse and important world-ranking and FedExCup points.
